candidate_requirements.requirement: Evolution and morphology of the rash, abdominal/joint symptoms and new urine findings
candidate_requirements.rationale: They materially change the problem beyond the prior infection label and are needed to weigh a systemic vasculitis against infection.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Focused history/examination description and review of repeat urinalysis, renal function and protein:creatinine trend.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as part of the next assessment at this decision point; not elicited in this written draft.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Timing, methods and prior interpretation of the infectious tests (malaria antigen/smears, EBV serology and DNA)
candidate_requirements.rationale: Conflicting antigen-positive, smear-negative results and a low-level EBV DNA need defensible reconciliation before any label is accepted.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Repeat smears/antigen confirmation, review of assay characteristics and exposure history (West Africa, Southeast Asia, Florida, chicken coop).
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as an immediate next diagnostic priority at this decision point.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Tissue evaluation of the purpura and/or kidney to characterise the suspected systemic vasculitis
candidate_requirements.rationale: Palpable purpura with new glomerular-type urinary abnormalities and small-bowel involvement requires histologic confirmation before immunosuppressive decisions.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Skin biopsy of a fresh purpuric lesion and/or renal evaluation with biopsy consideration, plus stool studies for gastrointestinal involvement.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as a next diagnostic priority at this decision point.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Baseline and scheduled monitoring of renal function, albumin, urine protein and inflammatory markers
candidate_requirements.rationale: New proteinuria with hypoalbuminaemia and oedema warrants planned reassessment to detect deterioration.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Any clinically equivalent monitoring plan using the already-available laboratory parameters.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as part of the monitoring priorities at this decision point.
